letter_deductions.deduction: Less: Room / ICU rent above eligible limit
Less: Crepe bandage - List I (not payable)
Less: Documentation charges - List II (part of room charges)
Less: Proportionate deduction (room category above eligibility)

letter_deductions.why: Road ambulance capped at 2,000 per hospitalisation (cl. 4.1.1(v)).

notes: Ambulance: the wording caps road ambulance at 2,000 per hospitalisation (cl. 4.1.1(v)) although List I item 67 says 'Ambulance'; the specific cover clause is read as overriding List I. Ambulance is treated as outside the Note 2 proportionate cut (transport, not a charge that varies with room category); if it were included, 2,000 x (1 - 2/3) = 667 more would be cut.
